sections.name: body
sections.value:
Final continuation supersedes the 03:42 pending-capability status: C33 stopped plan 223 and closed #183 unmerged. C34 now limits reviews to two rounds; later blocks require normal-use correctness failures. Optional hardening and additional fixtures are named C34 follow-ups, not gates. Spoonbill remains the reviewer; bobcat has no pending work.

The new lesson from #197 is admission versus settlement. Generic SqliteQueue::enqueue deduplicates only live pending/running rows; after ACK, the same key can enqueue again. A saved route is not proof that a notice was admitted. Setting a committed bit before enqueue trades duplication for silent loss; PM rejected that trade. The final repair writes orphan record, local Telegram queue row and notified mark in one shared-SQLite transaction.

On prime replay, inspect earlier admission before current owner/prime liveness or warmth. After accept returns an error, inspect admission again: DeliveryAuditFailed can follow real admission, so an error alone cannot authorize fallback. An unreadable admission ledger is unknown, not refusal. Settled routing must outlive owner revival.

Check ordering before trusting backoff: a Done/timed-out log read before settlement routing bypassed both orphan completion and the minute brake. The final code routes settlement/owner first and brakes required tail-read failures. SQL excludes waiting jobs before hydration; skip-list binding/membership still has per-tick cost.
